feature: Immutable artifact sharing through ordinary Whisper direct messages
implemented: Existing artifact cards and opened originals offer Send to a friend through the existing recipient tray.
Confirmed ordinary direct-message delivery retains existing contact enforcement, UUID reconciliation and optional note delivery.
Authenticated resolution verifies the actual caller-visible message, direct thread, participants, current contact permission and sender-owned grant.
Attribution is resolved from the sender account's Whisper profile, not client-supplied file or message attribution.
Received cards reuse the existing document renderer and isolated local HTML page; all declared bundle resources are hash-verified before loading.
Save explicitly copies immutable original bytes into existing recipient document storage and the actual account-bound recipient workspace.
Workspace publication uses bounded fixed data-only import jobs, no-follow directories, exclusive publication and independent final file hash verification.
Durable job intent precedes dispatch; uncertain or failed transfers are not replayed. Explicit retry checks known receipts and resumes subsequent undispatched steps.
Recipient provenance is retained in owned metadata and the workspace; sender browser data and game progress are not transferred.
DM page storage is account/message-qualified and remains stable when the saved storage ID changes. Native account changes invalidate private attachment access.

backendStatic.note: Current diagnostic output contains no errors in the artifact-sharing, import, document or shell modules; unrelated inherited entrypoint/other-module diagnostics remain.

limitations: No two-account/device acceptance has run. Compilation and deployment do not establish DM delivery, gameplay controls, workspace importer behavior or byte-fidelity round trips.
Unsaved shares still depend on original retention and current messaging permission. Only completed workspace saves are independent recipient copies.
Workspace saving proceeds in bounded steps while the recipient keeps saving active; backgrounding or pausing stops further dispatch, but an already dispatched data-only chunk can finish.
Uncertain or definitively failed import jobs are not replayed; a fresh share may be required after a failed transfer.
This implementation targets the selected native app. The web client is unchanged.
